step-2006-p2-q2.summary: Use the exponential series to enclose $e$ strictly between $8/3$ and $67/24$, proving $n!>2^n$ for $n\ge4$ along the way. For $F(x)=3e^{2x}+14\ln(4/3-x)$, locate a local minimum in $(1/2,1)$ and describe its graph over the entire domain.
step-2006-p2-q2.summaryZh: 利用指数函数的幂级数证明 $8/3<e<67/24$，其中要证明 $n\ge4$ 时 $n!>2^n$。对 $F(x)=3e^{2x}+14\ln(4/3-x)$，证明 $(1/2,1)$ 内存在极小点，并画出定义域内的曲线。
step-2006-p2-q2.answer: $8/3<e<67/24$. There is a minimum in $(1/2,5/6)$, then a maximum in $(1,4/3)$.

methods.title: Bound the tail and track the derivative
methods.titleZh: 先估计级数余项，再判断导数符号
steps: The terms through $1/3!$ sum to $8/3$, and all later terms are positive. The inequality $4!>2^4$ starts an induction: multiplying by $n+1>2$ preserves it. Thus the remaining series is less than $\sum_{n=4}^{\infty}2^{-n}=1/8$, giving the upper bound.

For $x<4/3$, $F\prime(x)$ has the sign of $h(x)-14$, where $h(x)=6(4/3-x)e^{2x}$. Since $h\prime(x)=6e^{2x}(5/3-2x)$, $h$ increases up to $5/6$ and then decreases. It tends to zero at both ends of the domain.

Now $h(1/2)=5e<14$ and $h(1)=2e^2>14$ by the bounds just proved. Thus $F$ decreases, increases, then decreases, with turning points in the stated intervals. It tends to $+\infty$ on the left and $-\infty$ as $x\to(4/3)^-$.

At a stationary point put $t=4/3-x>0$: $F=7/t+14\ln t$. The last expression has minimum $14(1-\ln 2)>0$ at $t=1/2$, so both turning points lie above the axis. The curve crosses the horizontal axis once, on its final descent.
stepsZh: 截至 $1/3!$ 的部分和为 $8/3$，其后各项为正。因 $4!>2^4$，且从 $n$ 到 $n+1$ 左边乘 $n+1>2$、右边乘 2，归纳得所需不等式。余项小于 $\sum_{n=4}^{\infty}2^{-n}=1/8$，从而得上界。
在 $x<4/3$ 上，$F\prime(x)$ 与 $h(x)-14$ 同号，其中 $h(x)=6(4/3-x)e^{2x}$。由 $h\prime(x)=6e^{2x}(5/3-2x)$，$h$ 在 $5/6$ 左侧递增、右侧递减；定义域两端的极限均为零。
利用前面的界，$h(1/2)=5e<14$，$h(1)=2e^2>14$。因此 $F$ 的单调性依次为减、增、减，两个转折点分属答案中的区间。左端 $F\to+\infty$，右端 $x\to(4/3)^-$ 时 $F\to-\infty$。
在驻点处令 $t=4/3-x$，则 $F=7/t+14\ln t$。这个式子在 $t=1/2$ 取得最小值 $14(1-\ln2)>0$，故两个转折点都在横轴上方，只有最后的下降段穿过横轴。

step-2006-p2-q6.summary: Use vector geometry to prove $(ax+by+cz)^2\le(a^2+b^2+c^2)(x^2+y^2+z^2)$ and characterize equality for all real entries. Deduce the sharp bound for $(x+2y+2z)^2$ in terms of $x^2+y^2+z^2$. Find every triple with $p^2+4q^2+9r^2=729$ and $8p+8q+3r=243$.
step-2006-p2-q6.summaryZh: 从向量点积证明 $(ax+by+cz)^2\le(a^2+b^2+c^2)(x^2+y^2+z^2)$，并完整讨论等号条件。求 $(x+2y+2z)^2$ 关于 $x^2+y^2+z^2$ 的最优上界，再解方程组 $p^2+4q^2+9r^2=729$、$8p+8q+3r=243$。
step-2006-p2-q6.answer: Equality means linear dependence. The sharp multiplier is $9$ and $(p,q,r)=(24,6,1)$.
step-2006-p2-q6.answerZh: 等号成立当且仅当两向量线性相关。最优常数为 $9$，且 $(p,q,r)=(24,6,1)$。

methods.title: Identify the equality case in the scalar product
methods.titleZh: 寻找点积何时达到上界
steps: For nonzero vectors $u=(a,b,c)$ and $v=(x,y,z)$, square $u\cdot v=\|u\|\|v\|\cos\theta$ and use $\cos^2\theta\le1$. Equality requires parallel or opposite directions. If either vector is zero, equality holds as well. These cases are exactly linear dependence.
Taking $u=(1,2,2)$ gives $(x+2y+2z)^2\le9(x^2+y^2+z^2)$, with equality when $v$ is a multiple of $u$. Hence $9$ is attained.

For the last system choose $u=(8,4,1)$, $v=(p,2q,3r)$. Their norms are $9,27$ and their scalar product is $243=9\cdot27$. They must point in the same direction, so $v=3u$. Reading the coordinates gives the stated triple.
stepsZh: 两向量 $u=(a,b,c)$、$v=(x,y,z)$ 都非零时，将 $u\cdot v=\|u\|\|v\|\cos\theta$ 平方，再用 $\cos^2\theta\le1$。等号要求两者同向或反向。若某个向量是零向量，等号也成立。合并即线性相关。
取 $u=(1,2,2)$，得到 $(x+2y+2z)^2\le9(x^2+y^2+z^2)$。令 $v$ 为 $u$ 的非零倍数就取等，所以常数 $9$ 已经最优。
再取 $u=(8,4,1)$、$v=(p,2q,3r)$。模分别为 $9,27$，点积恰等于 $243=9\cdot27$，故两者同向，于是 $v=3u$。比较各分量便得唯一解。

step-2006-p2-q11.summary: A unit mass is fired from ground level with speed $u$ at elevation $\theta$ towards north. Its accelerations are $-f$ northwards and $-g$ upwards, with $f,g>0$. Find its signed northerly range and the limiting elevation beyond which horizontal velocity reverses before landing. Compare the range at $45^\circ$ with the maximum northerly range, and describe the $45^\circ$ trajectory when $f=g$.
step-2006-p2-q11.summaryZh: 一质点从地面以速率 $u$ 向北斜抛，仰角为 $\theta$。取向北、向上为正，加速度分别为 $-f,-g$，其中 $f,g>0$。求带方向的向北射程、落地前水平速度反向的临界仰角、$45^\circ$ 时射程与最大向北射程之比，并描述 $f=g$ 时 $45^\circ$ 斜抛的运动。

methods.title: Use the flight time before maximising the range
methods.titleZh: 由飞行时间求射程，再求三角函数最值
steps: At time $t$, $x=ut\cos\theta-ft^2/2$ and $y=ut\sin\theta-gt^2/2$. Setting $y=0$ gives the landing time $T=2u\sin\theta/g$. Substituting into $x$ yields the displayed formula. A negative signed range denotes landing south of the start; the ordinary distance is $|R|$.
The northward velocity changes sign at $t=u\cos\theta/f$. This is strictly before $T$ exactly when $\tan\theta>g/(2f)$. Equality is the limiting case in which the reversal would occur at landing.

The maximum of $g\sin2\theta+f\cos2\theta$ is $\sqrt{g^2+f^2}$, attained at $\tan2\theta=g/f$ in the first quadrant. At $45^\circ$ the expression is $g$, giving the ratio. For the ratio of unsigned distances use $|g-f|$ in its numerator.
When $f=g$ at $45^\circ$, $x(t)=y(t)=ut/\sqrt2-gt^2/2$. The particle goes up a straight line of slope one, stops momentarily at $t=u/(\sqrt2 g)$, and retraces the line to its starting point.
stepsZh: 位移分量为 $x=ut\cos\theta-ft^2/2$、$y=ut\sin\theta-gt^2/2$。取 $y=0$ 的正根 $T=2u\sin\theta/g$，代入 $x$ 并用二倍角公式即得射程。若 $R<0$，落点在起点以南，几何距离为 $|R|$。
水平速度在 $t=u\cos\theta/f$ 变号。该时刻小于 $T$ 等价于 $\tan\theta>g/(2f)$。等号表示恰在落地时水平速度变为零。
$g\sin2\theta+f\cos2\theta$ 的最大值为 $\sqrt{g^2+f^2}$，取等时 $2\theta$ 在第一象限且 $\tan2\theta=g/f$。仰角 $45^\circ$ 时该式为 $g$，故得答案中的比值。若比较无方向的距离，则分子取 $|g-f|$。
$f=g$ 且仰角为 $45^\circ$ 时，两坐标始终相等，均为 $ut/\sqrt2-gt^2/2$。质点沿倾角为 $45^\circ$ 的直线上升，在 $t=u/(\sqrt2g)$ 时瞬间静止，再原路返回地面起点。

step-2006-p2-q12.summary: Three bowlers each make $30$ attempts. Their respective per-attempt wicket probabilities are $1/36,1/25,1/41$. In an independent binomial model, exactly one wicket fell: how likely was it taken by the first bowler? Find the mean total, select an approximation using mean about three, and estimate the chance of at least five wickets using $e^3\approx20$.
step-2006-p2-q12.summaryZh: 三位投手各投球 $30$ 次，每次取得一个三柱门的概率依次为 $1/36,1/25,1/41$。设每球独立，已知全场恰有一次成功，求它来自第一位的概率。计算总成功数均值，再以接近 3 的均值作近似，用 $e^3\approx20$ 估算至少成功五次的概率。
step-2006-p2-q12.answer: $3/10$; the exact mean is $3401/1230\approx2.765$. With a Poisson mean of three the tail is about $0.18$, roughly one fifth.
step-2006-p2-q12.answerZh: $3/10$；总均值为 $3401/1230\approx2.765$。取均值为 3 的泊松近似，尾概率约为 $0.18$，即接近五分之一。

methods.title: Cancel the common all-failure probability
methods.titleZh: 约去所有投球都失败的共同因子
steps: Let $B$ denote the probability that all 90 attempts fail. If precisely one succeeds and is by bowler $i$, its probability is $30B\,p_i/(1-p_i)$. Thus conditioning on one wicket leaves the weights $1/35,1/24,1/40$. Their ratio is $24:35:21$, giving $24/80=3/10$.

By linearity of expectation the mean is $30(1/36+1/25+1/41)=3401/1230$. There are many independent trials and every success probability is small, so an approximate Poisson model is reasonable. Following the suggested rounding, set its parameter to $3$.
The complementary probability through four successes is $e^{-3}(1+3+9/2+27/6+81/24)=131e^{-3}/8$. Substituting $e^3\approx20$ gives a tail of $1-131/160=29/160\approx0.181$.
stepsZh: 令 $B$ 为 90 球全部失败的概率。仅第 $i$ 位投手有一次成功的概率为 $30B\,p_i/(1-p_i)$。以总成功数等于 1 为条件，三位投手的权重为 $1/35,1/24,1/40$，即 $24:35:21$。第一位的概率便是 $24/80=3/10$。
由期望的线性性，均值为 $30(1/36+1/25+1/41)=3401/1230$。试验次数多、相互独立且单次成功率小，可用泊松近似。依题意把均值取整为 $3$。

step-2006-p2-q13.summary: There are $n\ge2$ different sizes of ice cream, arriving once each in randomly shuffled order. Discard the first and take the first subsequent one larger than it. If none is larger, take the final offer. Rank $1$ means largest. Find the full rank distribution when $n=4$, then a formula for the probability of acquiring rank $1$ for general $n$.
step-2006-p2-q13.summaryZh: 有 $n\ge2$ 种大小互不相同的冰淇淋，以随机顺序每种出现一次。跳过第一份，以后遇到第一份比它大的就选；若始终没有，则选最后一份。最大者名次为 1。求 $n=4$ 时所选名次的完整分布，并对一般 $n$ 给出选中最大者的概率。
step-2006-p2-q13.answer: For ranks $1,2,3,4$ the probabilities are $(11,7,4,2)/24$. For general $n$ the probability of rank one is $n^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{n-1}1/j$.

methods.title: Condition on the rank of the initial offer
steps: Each first rank $r$ has probability $1/n$. For $r>1$, the first of the $r-1$ better offers is uniformly distributed over ranks $1,\ldots,r-1$ by symmetry. For $r=1$, the compulsory last offer is uniform over $2,\ldots,n$.

When $n=4$, rank 1 has probability $(1+1/2+1/3)/4=11/24$. Rank 2 has probability $(1/3+1/2+1/3)/4=7/24$, where the first term is the fallback. Rank 3 has probability $(1/3+1/3)/4=4/24$, and rank 4 can occur only by fallback, with probability $1/12$.
For arbitrary $n$, the case $r=1$ cannot yield the top rank. Summing its conditional probabilities $1/(r-1)$ for $r=2,\ldots,n$ gives the harmonic-sum formula.
stepsZh: 第一份名次为 $r$ 的概率均为 $1/n$。若 $r>1$，比它大的 $r-1$ 份中谁最先出现是等可能的，故实际选择在名次 $1,\ldots,r-1$ 中均匀分布。若 $r=1$，则最后一份在名次 $2,\ldots,n$ 中均匀分布。
一般地，$r=1$ 时选不到第一名；其余情况的条件概率为 $1/(r-1)$。对 $r=2,\ldots,n$ 加权求和，便得答案中的调和和式。

step-2006-p2-q1.summary: Let $u_1=2$ and $u_{n+1}=k-36/u_n$. (i) Find all $k$ for which the sequence has least period $1$, $2$, or $4$. (ii) For $k=37$, prove $u_n\ge2$ for every $n$ and, assuming convergence, determine the limit.
step-2006-p2-q1.summaryZh: 设 $u_1=2$，且 $u_{n+1}=k-36/u_n$。（i）分别求数列的最小周期为 $1,2,4$ 时的全部 $k$；（ii）当 $k=37$ 时，证明对所有 $n$ 均有 $u_n\ge2$，并在已知数列收敛的条件下求其极限。
step-2006-p2-q1.answer: Least periods $1,2,4$ occur for $k=20$, $k=0$, and $k=\pm6\sqrt2$, respectively. For $k=37$ the limit is $36$.
step-2006-p2-q1.answerZh: 最小周期为 $1,2,4$ 时分别有 $k=20$、$k=0$、$k=\pm6\sqrt2$。当 $k=37$ 时极限为 $36$。

methods.title: Close each cycle and then use an invariant lower bound
methods.titleZh: 令周期闭合，再用下界不变量求极限
steps: A period closes once $u_{p+1}=u_1=2$, because the recurrence then forces every later term to repeat. For period one, $u_2=k-18=2$, so $k=20$.
For period two, $u_3=k-36/(k-18)=2$. This gives $k(k-20)=0$. The value $20$ already has period one, whereas $k=0$ gives $2,-18,2,-18,\ldots$; hence the least period is two only for $k=0$.

For period four, compute $u_3=(k^2-18k-36)/(k-18)$ and $u_4=(k^3-18k^2-72k+648)/(k^2-18k-36)$. The condition $u_5=2$ reduces to $k(k-20)(k^2-72)=0$. Excluding the smaller periods leaves $k=\pm6\sqrt2$; direct substitution confirms that no denominator vanishes.
Now take $k=37$. If $u_n\ge2$, then $0<36/u_n\le18$, so $u_{n+1}=37-36/u_n\ge19\ge2$. Since $u_1=2$, induction proves the required bound.

If $u_n\to\ell$, the bound gives $\ell\ge2$, so it is legitimate to pass to the limit in the reciprocal. Thus $\ell=37-36/\ell$, or $(\ell-1)(\ell-36)=0$. The lower bound excludes $1$, hence $\ell=36$.
stepsZh: 只要 $u_{p+1}=u_1=2$，递推关系就会迫使以后各项逐项重复，周期即闭合。周期为 1 时，$u_2=k-18=2$，故 $k=20$。
周期为 2 时，令 $u_3=k-36/(k-18)=2$，得到 $k(k-20)=0$。其中 $k=20$ 已是常数列；$k=0$ 时数列为 $2,-18,2,-18,\ldots$，所以最小周期为 2 恰对应 $k=0$。
若 $u_n\to\ell$，则 $\ell\ge2$，可以对倒数取极限。于是 $\ell=37-36/\ell$，即 $(\ell-1)(\ell-36)=0$。下界排除 $\ell=1$，故 $\ell=36$。

step-2006-p2-q3.summary: (i) Prove that $(5+\sqrt{24})^4+(5+\sqrt{24})^{-4}$ is an integer, establish $0.1<(5+\sqrt{24})^{-1}<2/19<0.11$, and find $(5+\sqrt{24})^4$ to four decimal places. (ii) For integers $N>1$ and $k>0$, bound the distance from $(N+\sqrt{N^2-1})^k$ to its nearest integer by $(2N-\tfrac12)^{-k}$.
step-2006-p2-q3.answer: The integer is $9602$ and $(5+\sqrt{24})^4=9601.9999$ to four decimal places. The stated general bound holds.
step-2006-p2-q3.answerZh: 该整数为 $9602$，且 $(5+\sqrt{24})^4=9601.9999$（精确到小数点后四位）。一般情形的不等式成立。

methods.title: Pair each quadratic surd with its conjugate
methods.titleZh: 将二次根式与其共轭配对
steps: Because $b=5-\sqrt{24}>0$, direct squaring gives $b>0.1$ and $b<2/19$; also $2/19<0.11$. Thus $0.0001<b^4<0.00014641$.
Since $a^4=9602-b^4$, we obtain $9601.99985359<a^4<9601.9999$, so the four-decimal value is $9601.9999$.
For the general case set $A=N+\sqrt{N^2-1}$ and $B=N-\sqrt{N^2-1}$. Then $AB=1$. The binomial expansions of $A^k$ and $B^k$ have opposite irrational terms, so $S_k=A^k+B^k$ is an integer.

Moreover $0<B<(2N-\tfrac12)^{-1}$: after taking reciprocals this is equivalent to $\sqrt{N^2-1}>N-\tfrac12$, whose square reduces to $N>5/4$. Therefore $0<B^k<(2N-\tfrac12)^{-k}$. Since $A^k=S_k-B^k$, its distance from the integer $S_k$, and hence from the nearest integer, satisfies the required bound.
stepsZh: 一般地，令 $A=N+\sqrt{N^2-1}$、$B=N-\sqrt{N^2-1}$，则 $AB=1$。展开 $A^k+B^k$ 时，含奇次根式的项两两抵消，所以 $S_k=A^k+B^k$ 是整数。
又有 $0<B<(2N-\tfrac12)^{-1}$：取倒数后等价于 $\sqrt{N^2-1}>N-\tfrac12$，平方后只需 $N>5/4$。故 $0<B^k<(2N-\tfrac12)^{-k}$。因 $A^k=S_k-B^k$，它到整数 $S_k$、从而到最近整数的距离满足所需上界。

step-2006-p2-q4.summary: First prove $\int_0^\pi x f(\sin x)\,dx=\frac\pi2\int_0^\pi f(\sin x)\,dx$ by substituting $x=\pi-t$. Then evaluate $\int_0^\pi \frac{x\sin x}{3+\sin^2x}\,dx$, $\int_0^{2\pi}\frac{x\sin x}{3+\sin^2x}\,dx$, and $\int_0^\pi\frac{x|\sin2x|}{3+\sin^2x}\,dx$.
step-2006-p2-q4.summaryZh: 先用代换 $x=\pi-t$ 证明 $\int_0^\pi x f(\sin x)\,dx=\frac\pi2\int_0^\pi f(\sin x)\,dx$，再计算 $\int_0^\pi \frac{x\sin x}{3+\sin^2x}\,dx$、$\int_0^{2\pi}\frac{x\sin x}{3+\sin^2x}\,dx$ 以及 $\int_0^\pi\frac{x|\sin2x|}{3+\sin^2x}\,dx$。

methods.title: Exploit reflection about $\pi/2$
methods.titleZh: 利用关于 $\pi/2$ 的对称性
steps: Let $I=\int_0^\pi x f(\sin x)\,dx$. Substituting $x=\pi-t$ gives $I=\pi\int_0^\pi f(\sin t)\,dt-I$, proving the identity.
For the first integral the identity reduces it to $(\pi/2)J$, where $J=\int_0^\pi\sin x/(3+\sin^2x)\,dx$. With $u=\cos x$, $J=\int_{-1}^1du/(4-u^2)=\tfrac12\ln3$, so the result is $\frac\pi4\ln3$.
For the range $[\pi,2\pi]$, write $x=\pi+t$. The integral becomes $-\pi J-\int_0^\pi t\sin t/(3+\sin^2t)\,dt=-\tfrac34\pi\ln3$. Adding the first-half value gives $-\frac\pi2\ln3$.
On $[0,\pi]$, $|\sin2x|=2\sin x|\cos x|$ is a function of $\sin x$, so the identity applies again. Symmetry about $\pi/2$ gives $\int_0^\pi |\sin2x|/(3+\sin^2x)\,dx=2\ln(4/3)$.
Multiplying the last value by $\pi/2$ yields $\pi\ln(4/3)$.
stepsZh: 令 $I=\int_0^\pi x f(\sin x)\,dx$。作代换 $x=\pi-t$，得到 $I=\pi\int_0^\pi f(\sin t)\,dt-I$，从而证明恒等式。
第一个积分由恒等式化为 $(\pi/2)J$，其中 $J=\int_0^\pi\sin x/(3+\sin^2x)\,dx$。令 $u=\cos x$，则 $J=\int_{-1}^1du/(4-u^2)=\tfrac12\ln3$，故结果为 $\frac\pi4\ln3$。
对区间 $[\pi,2\pi]$ 令 $x=\pi+t$，该段积分为 $-\pi J-\int_0^\pi t\sin t/(3+\sin^2t)\,dt=-\tfrac34\pi\ln3$。再加上前半段，得到 $-\frac\pi2\ln3$。
在 $[0,\pi]$ 上，$|\sin2x|=2\sin x|\cos x|$ 可写成 $\sin x$ 的函数，所以仍可使用恒等式。关于 $\pi/2$ 的对称性给出 $\int_0^\pi |\sin2x|/(3+\sin^2x)\,dx=2\ln(4/3)$。
将最后的积分乘以 $\pi/2$，即得 $\pi\ln(4/3)$。

step-2006-p2-q5.summary: Let $\lfloor x\rfloor$ be the greatest integer not exceeding $x$. (i) Compare $y=x^2+3x-1$ with $y=x^2+3\lfloor x\rfloor-1$, sketching them on $1\le x\le3$, and find the enclosed area on $1\le x\le n$. (ii) Repeat for $y=\lfloor x\rfloor^2+3\lfloor x\rfloor-1$ and prove the stated area formula.
step-2006-p2-q5.summaryZh: 设 $\lfloor x\rfloor$ 为不超过 $x$ 的最大整数。（i）比较 $y=x^2+3x-1$ 与 $y=x^2+3\lfloor x\rfloor-1$，在 $1\le x\le3$ 上作图，并求 $1\le x\le n$ 间的面积；（ii）将第二条曲线改为 $y=\lfloor x\rfloor^2+3\lfloor x\rfloor-1$，作图并证明给定的面积公式。
step-2006-p2-q5.answer: The areas are $\frac32(n-1)$ in (i) and $\frac16(n-1)(3n+11)$ in (ii).

methods.title: Integrate one unit strip at a time
methods.titleZh: 逐个单位区间计算面积
steps: Write $f(x)=x^2+3x-1$. It is increasing for $x\ge1$. In part (i), on $k\le x<k+1$ the lower curve is $x^2+3k-1$, a parabolic piece meeting $f$ at the left endpoint; the vertical gap is $3(x-k)$.

Each unit strip therefore has area $\int_k^{k+1}3(x-k)\,dx=3/2$. There are $n-1$ strips, giving $\frac32(n-1)$. On $[1,3]$ the lower pieces rise from $3$ towards $6$, jump to $9$, and rise towards $14$, while $f$ passes through $(1,3),(2,9),(3,17)$.
In part (ii), the lower graph is the step function $f(\lfloor x\rfloor)$: it equals $3$ on $[1,2)$ and $9$ on $[2,3)$. Since $f$ is increasing, it stays below $f(x)$.
On $[k,k+1]$ put $x=k+t$. The gap is $f(k+t)-f(k)=2kt+t^2+3t$, whose integral from $0$ to $1$ is $k+11/6$.
Summing for $k=1,\ldots,n-1$ gives $\frac12n(n-1)+\frac{11}{6}(n-1)=\frac16(n-1)(3n+11)$.
stepsZh: 记 $f(x)=x^2+3x-1$；它在 $x\ge1$ 上递增。（i）中，当 $k\le x<k+1$ 时，下方曲线为 $x^2+3k-1$，它在左端点与 $f$ 相交，两曲线的竖直距离为 $3(x-k)$。
每个单位条带的面积为 $\int_k^{k+1}3(x-k)\,dx=3/2$。共有 $n-1$ 个条带，故总面积为 $\frac32(n-1)$。在 $[1,3]$ 上，下方曲线从 $3$ 增至接近 $6$，跳到 $9$ 后增至接近 $14$；上方抛物线经过 $(1,3),(2,9),(3,17)$。
（ii）中，下方图像是阶梯函数 $f(\lfloor x\rfloor)$：在 $[1,2)$ 上等于 $3$，在 $[2,3)$ 上等于 $9$。由于 $f$ 递增，阶梯始终位于 $f(x)$ 下方。

step-2006-p2-q7.summary: For the ellipse $x^2/a^2+y^2/b^2=1$, derive the tangent at $(a\cos\alpha,b\sin\alpha)$. With $A=(-a,-b)$, $E=(-a,0)$ and $P=(a,kb)$, the line through $E$ parallel to $AP$ meets $y=b$ at $Q$. Prove that $PQ$ is tangent at the point satisfying $\tan(\alpha/2)=k$, and decide whether the result remains valid for $k=0$ and $k=1$.
step-2006-p2-q7.summaryZh: 对椭圆 $x^2/a^2+y^2/b^2=1$，推导其在 $(a\cos\alpha,b\sin\alpha)$ 处的切线。设 $A=(-a,-b)$、$E=(-a,0)$、$P=(a,kb)$，过 $E$ 作 $AP$ 的平行线并与 $y=b$ 交于 $Q$。证明 $PQ$ 在满足 $\tan(\alpha/2)=k$ 的点处与椭圆相切，并判断 $k=0,1$ 时结论是否仍成立。
step-2006-p2-q7.answer: The tangent is $y=-(b/a)\cot\alpha\,x+b\csc\alpha$. The construction works for $0\le k\le1$, including both endpoints.
step-2006-p2-q7.answerZh: 切线为 $y=-(b/a)\cot\alpha\,x+b\csc\alpha$。该构造对 $0\le k\le1$ 均成立，包括两个端点。

methods.title: Match the constructed line with the half-angle tangent form
methods.titleZh: 将构造直线与半角形式的切线配对
steps: Implicit differentiation gives $dy/dx=-b^2x/(a^2y)$. At $(a\cos\alpha,b\sin\alpha)$ this yields $y=-(b/a)\cot\alpha\,x+b\csc\alpha$.
The slope of $AP$ is $(1+k)b/(2a)$. Its parallel through $E$ meets $y=b$ at $Q=(a(1-k)/(1+k),b)$.
Using $P=(a,kb)$ and this $Q$, the line $PQ$ is $y=-(b/a)(1-k^2)/(2k)\,x+b(1+k^2)/(2k)$.
If $\tan(\alpha/2)=k$, the half-angle identities give $\cot\alpha=(1-k^2)/(2k)$ and $\csc\alpha=(1+k^2)/(2k)$. Thus $PQ$ is exactly the tangent, at $(a(1-k^2)/(1+k^2),2kb/(1+k^2))$.

When $k=0$, $P=(a,0)$ and $Q=(a,b)$, so $PQ$ is the vertical tangent $x=a$ at $\alpha=0$. When $k=1$, $P=(a,b)$ and $Q=(0,b)$, so $PQ$ is the horizontal tangent $y=b$ at $\alpha=\pi/2$. Hence the geometric result survives both endpoint cases.
stepsZh: 对椭圆方程作隐函数求导，得 $dy/dx=-b^2x/(a^2y)$。代入 $(a\cos\alpha,b\sin\alpha)$，得到切线 $y=-(b/a)\cot\alpha\,x+b\csc\alpha$。
$AP$ 的斜率为 $(1+k)b/(2a)$。过 $E$ 的平行线与 $y=b$ 相交于 $Q=(a(1-k)/(1+k),b)$。
若 $\tan(\alpha/2)=k$，半角公式给出 $\cot\alpha=(1-k^2)/(2k)$、$\csc\alpha=(1+k^2)/(2k)$。故 $PQ$ 正是椭圆切线，切点为 $(a(1-k^2)/(1+k^2),2kb/(1+k^2))$。
当 $k=0$ 时，$P=(a,0)$、$Q=(a,b)$，所以 $PQ$ 是 $\alpha=0$ 处的竖直切线 $x=a$；当 $k=1$ 时，$P=(a,b)$、$Q=(0,b)$，所以 $PQ$ 是 $\alpha=\pi/2$ 处的水平切线 $y=b$。两个端点情形均成立。

step-2006-p2-q8.summary: Prove that the line through position vectors $\mathbf x,\mathbf y$ is $\mathbf r=(1-\alpha)\mathbf x+\alpha\mathbf y$. In trapezium $OABC$, $OA\parallel CB$ and $OA>CB$. Point $E$ divides $OA$ in the ratio $1:2$, $F$ is the midpoint of $CB$, $D=OC\cap AB$ after both sides are produced, $G=OB\cap EF$, and $H=DG\cap OA$. With $\vec{OA}=\mathbf a$ and $\vec{OC}=\mathbf c$, find all five position vectors and $OH:HA$.
step-2006-p2-q8.summaryZh: 证明过位置向量为 $\mathbf x,\mathbf y$ 两点的直线可写为 $\mathbf r=(1-\alpha)\mathbf x+\alpha\mathbf y$。在梯形 $OABC$ 中，$OA\parallel CB$ 且 $OA>CB$；$E$ 将 $OA$ 按 $1:2$ 分割，$F$ 为 $CB$ 中点，$D$ 是 $OC$ 与 $AB$ 延长线的交点，$G=OB\cap EF$，$H=DG\cap OA$。设 $\vec{OA}=\mathbf a$、$\vec{OC}=\mathbf c$，求五个点的位置向量及 $OH:HA$。
step-2006-p2-q8.answer: Writing $\vec{OB}=\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c$ with $0<\lambda<1$, the vectors are $\mathbf d=\mathbf c/(1-\lambda)$, $\mathbf e=\mathbf a/3$, $\mathbf f=\lambda\mathbf a/2+\mathbf c$, $\mathbf g=2(\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c)/(3\lambda+2)$, and $\mathbf h=2\mathbf a/5$. Thus $OH:HA=2:3$.
step-2006-p2-q8.answerZh: 写成 $\vec{OB}=\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c$（$0<\lambda<1$）后，有 $\mathbf d=\mathbf c/(1-\lambda)$、$\mathbf e=\mathbf a/3$、$\mathbf f=\lambda\mathbf a/2+\mathbf c$、$\mathbf g=2(\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c)/(3\lambda+2)$、$\mathbf h=2\mathbf a/5$，故 $OH:HA=2:3$。

methods.title: Intersect affine line parametrisations
steps: A line through $\mathbf x$ in direction $\mathbf y-\mathbf x$ has $\mathbf r=\mathbf x+\alpha(\mathbf y-\mathbf x)=(1-\alpha)\mathbf x+\alpha\mathbf y$. Since $CB\parallel OA$, write $\vec{OB}=\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c$; the length condition gives $0<\lambda<1$.

Ratios immediately give $\mathbf e=\mathbf a/3$ and $\mathbf f=(\mathbf c+\vec{OB})/2=\lambda\mathbf a/2+\mathbf c$. Intersecting $OC$ with $AB$ and comparing the independent coefficients of $\mathbf a,\mathbf c$ gives $\mathbf d=\mathbf c/(1-\lambda)$.
A point on $OB$ is $t(\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c)$. Equating it to a point on $EF$ gives $t=2/(3\lambda+2)$, so $\mathbf g=2(\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c)/(3\lambda+2)$.
Parametrise $DG$ by $(1-s)\mathbf d+s\mathbf g$. At $H\in OA$, its coefficient of $\mathbf c$ must vanish. This gives $s=(3\lambda+2)/(5\lambda)$.
The remaining coefficient of $\mathbf a$ is $2/5$, hence $\mathbf h=2\mathbf a/5$. Therefore $OH=(2/5)OA$ and $HA=(3/5)OA$, so $OH:HA=2:3$.
stepsZh: 过 $\mathbf x$ 且方向为 $\mathbf y-\mathbf x$ 的直线满足 $\mathbf r=\mathbf x+\alpha(\mathbf y-\mathbf x)=(1-\alpha)\mathbf x+\alpha\mathbf y$。由 $CB\parallel OA$，可写 $\vec{OB}=\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c$；长度条件给出 $0<\lambda<1$。
由分点关系直接得 $\mathbf e=\mathbf a/3$、$\mathbf f=(\mathbf c+\vec{OB})/2=\lambda\mathbf a/2+\mathbf c$。联立 $OC$ 与 $AB$ 的参数式，比较线性无关的 $\mathbf a,\mathbf c$ 系数，得到 $\mathbf d=\mathbf c/(1-\lambda)$。
$OB$ 上的点可写为 $t(\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c)$。将它与 $EF$ 上的点相等，得 $t=2/(3\lambda+2)$，所以 $\mathbf g=2(\lambda\mathbf a+\mathbf c)/(3\lambda+2)$。
将 $DG$ 参数化为 $(1-s)\mathbf d+s\mathbf g$。因为 $H\in OA$，其 $\mathbf c$ 的系数必须为零，从而 $s=(3\lambda+2)/(5\lambda)$。
此时 $\mathbf a$ 的系数为 $2/5$，故 $\mathbf h=2\mathbf a/5$。于是 $OH=(2/5)OA$、$HA=(3/5)OA$，所以 $OH:HA=2:3$。

step-2006-p2-q9.summary: A uniform ladder of length $6a$ and weight $W$ rests against a smooth wall at angle $\arctan2$ with its foot at the centre of a square table top of side $a/2$ and leg height $a$. A painter of weight $kW$ climbs the ladder. The ladder-table friction coefficient is $1/2$. (i) If the table is fixed, prove the ladder never slips. (ii) For $k=9$ and table-ground friction coefficient $1/3$, determine whether the unfixed table first slides or tilts.
step-2006-p2-q9.summaryZh: 一架长 $6a$、重 $W$ 的均匀梯子以倾角 $\arctan2$ 靠在光滑墙上，梯脚位于方形桌面中心；桌面边长 $a/2$、桌腿长 $a$。重为 $kW$ 的油漆工沿梯子上爬，梯脚与桌面间摩擦系数为 $1/2$。（i）若桌腿固定，证明梯子始终不会滑动；（ii）当 $k=9$ 且桌腿与地面摩擦系数为 $1/3$ 时，判断未固定的桌子先滑动还是先倾倒。
step-2006-p2-q9.answer: The ladder never slips on the table. For $k=9$, the table tilts first, when the painter is $11a/3$ along the ladder; sliding would begin only at $x=5a$.
step-2006-p2-q9.answerZh: 梯子不会在桌面上滑动。当 $k=9$ 时，油漆工沿梯子上升到 $11a/3$ 处，桌子先发生倾倒；若要滑动则需到 $x=5a$。

methods.title: Compare the friction and toppling thresholds
methods.titleZh: 比较滑动与倾倒的临界条件
steps: Let the painter be distance $x$ from the foot. If $R,F$ are the vertical and horizontal forces at the foot and $S$ is the wall reaction, equilibrium gives $R=(k+1)W$ and $F=S$. Taking moments about the foot yields $F=W(3+kx/a)/12$.
This is largest at $x=6a$, where $F_{\max}=(2k+1)W/4$. The limiting friction on the table is $R/2=(2k+2)W/4$, which is larger. Thus the ladder itself cannot slip for any position.
For $k=9$, the ladder exerts $10W$ downward and $F=W(1+3x/a)/4$ horizontally on the table. Including the table's own weight, the ground's total normal reaction is $12W$.

About the feet of the far pair of legs, the downward forces have restoring moment $12W(a/4)=3Wa$, while the horizontal push has overturning moment $Fa$. The near-leg reaction vanishes when $F=3W$, giving $x=11a/3$.
The maximum total ground friction is $(1/3)(12W)=4W$, so sliding would begin when $F=4W$, giving $x=5a$. Since $11a/3<5a$, tilting occurs first, and the available friction has not yet been exhausted.
stepsZh: 设油漆工距梯脚为 $x$。记梯脚处竖直支持力、水平摩擦力为 $R,F$，墙面支持力为 $S$。平衡条件给出 $R=(k+1)W$、$F=S$。对梯脚取矩，得到 $F=W(3+kx/a)/12$。
$F$ 在 $x=6a$ 时最大，$F_{\max}=(2k+1)W/4$。桌面可提供的最大摩擦力为 $R/2=(2k+2)W/4$，始终更大，所以梯子本身不会滑动。
当 $k=9$ 时，梯子对桌面施加 $10W$ 的向下压力及 $F=W(1+3x/a)/4$ 的水平力。加上桌子自重，地面对桌腿的总支持力为 $12W$。
以远离墙面的两条桌腿底端连线为轴，向下合力的恢复力矩为 $12W(a/4)=3Wa$，水平力的倾覆力矩为 $Fa$。靠墙侧桌腿支持力降为零时 $F=3W$，解得 $x=11a/3$。
地面可提供的最大总摩擦力为 $(1/3)(12W)=4W$，滑动临界点满足 $F=4W$，即 $x=5a$。因 $11a/3<5a$，桌子先倾倒，此时地面摩擦尚未达到极限。

step-2006-p2-q10.summary: Particles $A,B,C$ of masses $m,km,3m$ lie in that order at rest on a smooth line. Particle $A$ is projected at speed $u$; the coefficients of restitution for $AB$ and $BC$ are $1/2$ and $1/4$. (i) Find the $k$ for which $A$ and $B$ collide again. (ii) When $k=1$ and $B,C$ initially differ by distance $d$, prove that the time between the two $AB$ collisions is $60d/(13u)$.
step-2006-p2-q10.summaryZh: 质量分别为 $m,km,3m$ 的粒子 $A,B,C$ 依次静止在同一直线上。$A$ 以速率 $u$ 射向 $B$；$AB$、$BC$ 碰撞的恢复系数分别为 $1/2$、$1/4$。（i）求使 $A,B$ 再次碰撞的 $k$ 的范围；（ii）当 $k=1$ 且 $B,C$ 初距为 $d$ 时，证明两次 $AB$ 碰撞之间的时间为 $60d/(13u)$。
step-2006-p2-q10.answer: A second $AB$ collision occurs exactly for $0<k<3/2$. For $k=1$ the elapsed time is $60d/(13u)$.
step-2006-p2-q10.answerZh: $A,B$ 再次碰撞当且仅当 $0<k<3/2$。当 $k=1$ 时，所需时间为 $60d/(13u)$。

methods.title: Solve both impacts, then treat the second meeting as pursuit
methods.titleZh: 依次求两次碰撞速度，再转化为追及问题
steps: After the first collision, momentum and $v_B-v_A=u/2$ give $v_B=3u/[2(1+k)]$ and $v_A=(2-k)u/[2(1+k)]$.
After $B$ hits $C$, momentum and $w_C-w_B=v_B/4$ give $w_B=3(4k-3)u/[8(1+k)(k+3)]$.
At that moment $A$ is behind $B$. They meet again exactly when the gap shrinks, i.e. $v_A>w_B$. Clearing positive factors reduces this to $(2k-3)(2k+11)<0$. Since $k>0$, the range is $0<k<3/2$.
For $k=1$, $v_A=u/4$, $v_B=3u/4$, and after the $BC$ collision $w_B=3u/64$. Particle $B$ reaches $C$ after $t_1=d/(3u/4)=4d/(3u)$; meanwhile $A$ travels $d/3$, leaving a gap $2d/3$.
The closing speed is $u/4-3u/64=13u/64$, so the chase takes $t_2=(2d/3)/(13u/64)=128d/(39u)$. Thus $t_1+t_2=60d/(13u)$.
stepsZh: 第一次碰撞后，由动量守恒和 $v_B-v_A=u/2$ 得 $v_B=3u/[2(1+k)]$、$v_A=(2-k)u/[2(1+k)]$。
$B$ 与 $C$ 碰撞后，由动量守恒和 $w_C-w_B=v_B/4$ 得 $w_B=3(4k-3)u/[8(1+k)(k+3)]$。
此时 $A$ 位于 $B$ 后方，两者再次相遇当且仅当间距缩小，即 $v_A>w_B$。约去正因子后化为 $(2k-3)(2k+11)<0$。由于 $k>0$，故 $0<k<3/2$。

step-2006-p2-q14.summary: Sketch $y=1/(x\ln x)$ for $x>0$, $x\ne1$. A continuous random variable has density $f(x)=\lambda/(x\ln x)$ on $[a,b]$ and zero elsewhere. (i) Find $\lambda$ for $a=1/4,b=1/2$. (ii) For $\lambda=1,a>1$, prove $b=a^e$. (iii) For $\lambda=1,a=e$, estimate $P(e^{3/2}\le X\le e^2)$ as $31/108$. (iv) Repeat when $a=e^{1/2}$.
step-2006-p2-q14.summaryZh: 作出 $y=1/(x\ln x)$（$x>0,x\ne1$）的图像。连续随机变量的密度在 $[a,b]$ 上为 $f(x)=\lambda/(x\ln x)$，其余处为零。（i）当 $a=1/4,b=1/2$ 时求 $\lambda$；（ii）当 $\lambda=1,a>1$ 时证明 $b=a^e$；（iii）当 $\lambda=1,a=e$ 时，用 $31/108$ 近似 $P(e^{3/2}\le X\le e^2)$；（iv）当 $a=e^{1/2}$ 时重新求该概率。
step-2006-p2-q14.answer: The graph has a left-branch maximum at $(e^{-1},-e)$ and vertical asymptote $x=1$. The answers are (i) $\lambda=-1/\ln2$; (ii) $b=a^e$; (iii) $\ln(4/3)\approx31/108$; (iv) $0$.
step-2006-p2-q14.answerZh: 图像左支在 $(e^{-1},-e)$ 取得极大，且 $x=1$ 为竖直渐近线。（i）$\lambda=-1/\ln2$；（ii）$b=a^e$；（iii）概率为 $\ln(4/3)\approx31/108$；（iv）概率为 $0$。

methods.title: Normalize with the antiderivative $\ln|\ln x|$
methods.titleZh: 利用原函数 $\ln|\ln x|$ 归一化
steps: The function is negative on $(0,1)$ and positive on $(1,\infty)$. It tends to $-\infty$ as $x\to0^+$ and $x\to1^-$, to $+\infty$ as $x\to1^+$, and to $0^+$ as $x\to\infty$. Since $y'=-(\ln x+1)/(x\ln x)^2$, the left branch has a maximum at $(e^{-1},-e)$ and the right branch decreases throughout.
Use $\int dx/(x\ln x)=\ln|\ln x|+C$. On $[1/4,1/2]$ the integral equals $-\ln2$, so normalization gives $\lambda=-1/\ln2$; this sign also makes the density non-negative.
If $\lambda=1$ and $a>1$, normalization gives $1=\ln(\ln b/\ln a)$. Hence $\ln b=e\ln a$ and $b=a^e$.

For $a=e$, the support is $[e,e^e]$, which contains $[e^{3/2},e^2]$. The desired probability is $\ln2-\ln(3/2)=\ln(4/3)$. With $\ln(1+t)=t-t^2/2+t^3/3-t^4/4+\cdots$ at $t=1/3$, four terms give $31/108$, with error below the next term.
For $a=e^{1/2}$, the upper endpoint is $b=e^{e/2}<e^{3/2}$ because $e<3$. The requested interval lies outside the support, so its probability is $0$.
stepsZh: 该函数在 $(0,1)$ 上为负，在 $(1,\infty)$ 上为正；当 $x\to0^+$、$x\to1^-$ 时趋于 $-\infty$，当 $x\to1^+$ 时趋于 $+\infty$，而当 $x\to\infty$ 时趋于 $0^+$。由 $y'=-(\ln x+1)/(x\ln x)^2$，左支在 $(e^{-1},-e)$ 取得极大，右支始终递减。
使用 $\int dx/(x\ln x)=\ln|\ln x|+C$。在 $[1/4,1/2]$ 上该积分等于 $-\ln2$，归一化得到 $\lambda=-1/\ln2$；这个负号也保证密度非负。
若 $\lambda=1$ 且 $a>1$，归一化条件为 $1=\ln(\ln b/\ln a)$。故 $\ln b=e\ln a$，即 $b=a^e$。
当 $a=e^{1/2}$ 时，上端点 $b=e^{e/2}<e^{3/2}$，因为 $e<3$。所求区间完全位于支持集右侧，所以概率为 $0$。
